copy.curiosityHook: Can Hawk outwit a mysterious cult and assemble the fabled relic before time runs out for his kidnapped ex?
copy.description: After adventurer Asian Hawk steals a legendary Crusades-era sword, a cult of Satanic monks abducts his ex-girlfriend to force him to track down the remaining pieces of the magical Armour of God.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast, comedic, and lighthearted action-adventure that offers high excitement with easy, low-effort viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Jackie Chan, this globe-trotting 1986 comedy adventure delivers high-spirited physical action, inventive set pieces, and a breezily fast-moving pace.

allowedMaterial: Asian Hawk steals a Crusades-era sword
The sword is part of the Armour of God
Monks demand he surrender the sword and gather the rest of the armour
excludedMaterial: How the armour pieces are recovered
Later plot twists or third-act resolutions
